# Third-party code in this folder

These files ship with the app so it works with no internet. They are
downloaded by `tools/vendor.py`, unchanged.

| File | Library | Author | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `html2pdf.bundle.min.js` | [html2pdf.js](https://github.com/eKoopmans/html2pdf.js) 0.10.1 (with html2canvas and jsPDF) | Erik Koopmans and contributors | MIT |
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) 1.4.4 | Kazuhiko Arase | MIT |
| `jsQR.js` | [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) 1.4.0 | Cosmo Wolfe | Apache License 2.0 — https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 |
